# ML-DSA negative corpus for origin-crypto. Generated by
# `python3 -I security/crypto/tools/mldsa_reference.py negative`; each expected
# result is the strict verdict of the independent pure-Python reference.
#   neg <set> <vector> <expected> <edits|none> <label>
# <vector> is a differential vector of the same set (its index in the sig lines).
# Edits, comma-separated, applied in order to that vector's key, context, message
# and signature:
#   sig^OFF:HEX  XOR HEX into the signature at byte offset OFF
#   sig=OFF:HEX  overwrite the signature at byte offset OFF with HEX
#   ctx=HEX|-    replace the context string; msg=HEX|- replace the message
#   pk=HEX       replace the public key
